cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Don’t Question the Premise
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The ghost's waiting at our breakfast table. Do we have cereal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it haunting our kitchen? We're already late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then give it the instant porridge. I'll find a bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would a dead person need feeding? I'm taking the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it in a travel cup. You can drop it at the cemetery on your way.

mechanism: A takes charge of breakfast and transport so every question about a ghost becomes an assigned practical next step.
confusable: Unlike explaining the haunting, A uses only the useful time and departure details embedded in B's questions.
comparison: A late departure can give a ghost a ride, unlike containing a leaking painting with fish.
seedUse: Use the canonical breakfast ghost and car sequence, making the final delivery referents explicit rather than relying on unstated movement.
